description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of test cases and setup routines for testing the behavior of 'git blame' with various ignore revisions and related options. It defines multiple test scenarios, including handling of revisions to ignore, unblamable lines, boundary conditions, and merge commits.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive name, executing the contained commands and expecting them to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes the command expecting it to fail, and validates the error output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock or timestamp for commit creation.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Creates a merge commit between two branches or commits.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of test cases execution.
